worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.summary: Stomps its weight into the ground and a fissure runs outward along the surface: only grounded foes are hit, those swept lose Speed and are shoved back, and the front leaves a short-lived crack. Deep Stomp is narrow and heavy with one extra Speed stage; Wide Stomp reaches further and casts faster.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.use.0: Shake several foes standing next to you
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.use.1: Clip the Speed of anyone charging in
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.use.2: Ignore airborne foes and hit the ones standing
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.use.3: Shove a ring of foes away when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.description.0: The fissure sweeps up to %2$s grounded foes, each taking about %1$s physical damage; airborne targets are safe. The target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.description.1: The fissure runs outward to %1$s blocks, sweeping the whole ring within %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.description.2: Those swept lose %1$s Speed stage(s) and are shoved about %2$s blocks outward.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.description.3: As the fissure passes, it throws up short cracks and grit along the front that then fade; the ground blocks themselves are not replaced.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.deep.on: Deep Stomp on: the fissure is about ×0.68 wide, each hit about 24%% stronger and drops one more Speed stage, shoving further, but wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.deep.off: Deep Stomp off (Wide Stomp): the fissure is about ×1.12 wide and each hit about 10%% weaker, but it casts faster and cools down sooner, for sweeping an area or chasing fast foes.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.growth.0: At level %1$s the stomp rises to %2$s power, the fissure to %3$s blocks, and the Speed drop to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.preference.de: On: a narrower, heavier fissure that drops one extra Speed stage, with a longer wind-up and cooldown, for crushing one tough target. Off: a wider, faster sweep for covering an area or catching fast foes.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion walks in instead of stomping; higher opens earlier but lets foes step away first.
With this on, the companion raises Bulldoze when 2 or more grounded foes stand inside its own reach, so one stomp catches the ring at its feet; off keeps the normal attack order.
worldcombat.skill.bulldoze.description.g: You must be standing on the ground to drive the stomp in; it cannot be cast while airborne, and you stay rooted through the wind-up and recovery.
